state:
**Goal `ext-image`: Stages 2 to 5 are done on disk, and Stage 6 (the feature proofs) is in progress.** ADR 0120, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* settle the design, and no session re-decides it.

The component is embedded and callable with no `nvs.toml` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc). The `Novis\Image` builder is Novis source in `extensions/image/nvs/`, and `rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`'s fragment says what it has and lacks. `nvs meta --json` lists the built-in classes, the roster gives a `Novis\` member the path `novis/<tail>/<member>`, and `docs/reference/novis/Image-Image.md` is the class intro.

Tests are closed for every `Novis\Image\Image` and `Novis\Image\Codec` member: `covers:` markers on the `tests/conformance/novis/` cases and on `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_pipeline.rs`, whose `each_pixel_step_changes_a_known_pixel_as_documented` covers the steps no other Rust test ran. `Image::resize` owes nothing: `docs/examples/novis/Image-Image/resize/`, its attack and bench, and a figure in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`.

**The acceptance check cannot pass as written:** `dossier-novis-image-pipeline` names `Novis\Image\Image::composite`, which the builder does not have (`rule:core-classes/image-pipeline` lists it as missing, and the guest's `run` skips `composite`), so `--only` refuses the whole list. Either `composite` is built (goal file's builder item names it) or it leaves the check; see the next group's last item.

items.text: **About, three examples, one attack and one bench for each remaining `Novis\Image\Image` member** (`open`, `create`, `fromRaw`, `info`, `crop`, `trim`, `rotate`, `flip`, `flatten`, `sharpen`, `blur`, `grayscale`, `brightness`, `contrast`, `gamma`, `tint`, `format`, `metadata`, `encode`, `variants`, `raw`), per `rule:testing/feature-proofs`, copying the shape of `docs/examples/novis/Image-Image/resize/` and `benches/members/novis/Image-Image/resize.nvs`. Tests are already done. Each member: `bun nv try` the programs, `bun nv proofs --bless` each example, `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only '<id>' --no-callgrind`, then `bun nv proofs --verify --only '<id>'`. Anchor: `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:49`.

**`Novis\Image\Color::rgba` and `::hex`, and the six enums**: Color owes a Rust-side `covers:` test (`rgba` also a second case) and the full proofs; the enums owe `about.md`, one example and one case each, under `docs/examples/types/Novis-Image-<Enum>/`. Anchor: `extensions/image/nvs/Color.nvs:8`.

**`Novis\Image\Codec`'s members, and its class card**: `nv proofs` says `Novis\Image\Codec` has no class card; it is the component's manifest-declared class, so find where the roster reads its card (`tools/nv/proofs/roster.ts`). Examples and bench may be `skip` entries in `data/proofs/policy.json` with the reason as the value. Anchor: `extensions/image/manifest.json:1`.

**`composite` in the acceptance check**: build `Image::composite` (builder in `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:152`, the guest's `composite` step in `extensions/image/src/ops.rs`) or move it to the goal that builds it and drop it from `dossier-novis-image-pipeline` in `data/goals/ext-image.json`; the goal file's builder item lists it, so building it is the default.

backlog: Enum case names cannot be printed (`$fit->name` does not exist), so an example labels a case with a `match`; `rule:enums/no-class-machinery` owns it.
`docs/perf/members.ndjson` records `growth: unclear` for the resize bench, because each operation is a guest call; read the record's `growth_notes` before calling it a regression.
